scope: Screening only; no production promotion or end-to-end speed claim.
conservative_integration_gate: For each C1 physical row0 and row3 configuration, sum gate/up/down median GPU times. Require at least3% reduction in all four fresh processes, and no individual gate/up/down median regression exceeding2% in any of those processes. Also report all batch widths without selecting only a favorable process.
pressure: 256MiB read/write scrub before every projection, on a separate GPU command; not proof of a fully cold hardware cache.
timing1: Retained diagnostic attempt, excluded from the declared decision. No timing metrics inspected before declaring the integration gate.
